points.why: Adds a referred-active stock with its own sign-up inflow and cancellation outflow, splitting the total into two stocks.
Defines referral_share as Active_referred / Active_total each period.
Gives each group its own churn rate and keeps them consistent via the two-stock split with a derived total.
Says to estimate churn rates from channel data and swing-test them, and explains the share rises with constant referral fraction due to accumulation.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects a fixed referred percentage as an assumption that can never change.
